web-guide-idea-73.audience: Creators learning to turn raw phone clips into a coherent reel.
web-guide-idea-73.offer: Guide a short edit with a clear beginning, middle and end. Make the session about storytelling and usable technique.
web-guide-idea-73.steps.0: Send a small practice brief and tool requirements.
web-guide-idea-73.steps.1: Trim clips, arrange a sequence and add readable captions.
web-guide-idea-73.steps.2: Review exports and discuss one improvement.
web-guide-idea-73.equipment: A phone with the chosen editor and practice clips. Participants need enough storage and battery.
web-guide-idea-73.returnReason: Follow with sessions on pacing, sound or a different story format.
web-guide-idea-73.promotion: Share a short original edit and specify the app and beginner requirements.
web-guide-idea-73.metadataTitle: Reel Editing Workshop — Creator Idea & Practical Guide · Saathum
web-guide-idea-73.metadataDescription: Guide participants through editing a short clip and give feedback on their results. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
